beats.say: Today's VS Code changelog: the top five changes from the last day.
One. When you're signed out, the Welcome page now offers Sign in to GitHub, instead of the Agents window invitation. A setting turns it off.
Two. In the Agents window, a session's first button is now New Nested Session, replacing Pin. One click starts a new chat inside it.
Three. Stable now shows the Agents window badge on the app icon by default. It counts the sessions waiting for your input.
Four. In Agent Host chats, slash fork now takes a prompt, sent in the fork right away, or a title, like Shorter tagline.
Five. VS Code links can now add a plugin marketplace, or install a plugin. VS Code asks first, and for installs, it warns that plugins can run code.
That's today's changelog. The full list is in the changelog channel.
